notes.title: Demo Update (Version 1.3.0)🎣
notes.content:
We have now released Version 1.3.0 of the Scale the Depths Demo, featuring new control schemes for the hook when diving in the depths. These include Mouse and Inverted Controls, both of which can be changed in the Settings. Classic controls are still available as well. 🎮



Also, a big thank you to everyone who has played the demo so far. We were floored by the amount of support we have received and how many of you expressed how much you liked the game. We also greatly appreciated the feedback on the demo, helping us make the appropriate tweaks to create a game everyone can enjoy. You all motivate us to keep pushing forward to make the full release something truly special. We hope you continue to enjoy the demo, and happy fishing. 🐡 🙌


Change Log

🐠  QOL Updates
*NEW* Mouse Hook Controls - Change in settings

*NEW* Inverted Hook Controls - Change in settings
🪼 Bug Fixes
Fixed ambient sound issues in the prep area

Fixed soft locking problems with customers
 🦦 UI & Sound Tweaks
Reduced knife swooping sound frequency 

Lowered shop bell jingle SFX

Minor Visual Updates
